name: GraphQL
attack_surface: GraphQL query paths, schema introspection queries, mutation definitions
common_misconfigurations: Introspection schema query enabled in production
Missing rate limits on nested object depth (DoS vulnerability)
Unauthenticated mutations exposing account status modifications
validation_methods: Run introspection queries to extract complete GraphQL schema
Test batch queries to evaluate resource exhaust bounds
evidence_requirements: Raw HTTP mutation request / response showing unauthorized modifications
false_positive_indicators: Generic error blocks returned with mock data keys
WAF blocking nested structures on the frontend
reporting_guidance: Privilege escalation mutations are critical focus areas; introspection is low value without sensitive database field leakage.
